name: Admin Proposal Contract Generate
description: Admin generates a development contract with ContractParamsModal. Two modes: 'Contrato por defecto' (fill contractor/client params form with auto-populated company settings) or 'Contrato personalizado' (paste/upload custom Markdown). Moving a sent or viewed proposal to negotiation calls save-and-negotiate; generating from the Documents tab of a negotiating proposal calls the contract update API. The Documents tab shows for sent/viewed/negotiating/accepted/rejected; generation is available from negotiating on. The list and editor keep the modal open with the draft when generation fails, allowing retry.
